reason: The vendor cost of an ACP turn moves from protocol_turn to the run it belongs to. One UPDATE of thread_run sets cost on the runs whose protocol_turn row carries one, found by primary key, stamping basis 'list' because Claude Code reported none before; protocol_turn then drops its cost column, which rewrites that table. Measured during authoring on one development machine: thread_run 25448 rows (max rowid 38698), protocol_turn 193 rows (max rowid 210), 161 with a cost.
